• AntiPattern — "Supertype-definition spare"
  hasDescription: Sparing a file just because it defines the supertype is backwards for base-plus-subclasses family files because it keeps a huge family file full and starves sibling files from the explore budget. Evidence: docs/design/adaptive-explore-sizing.md#1 Dead ends item 5 says Django `compiler.py` is 2,266 lines, Read anyway, and sparing it regressed Django to 9% costlier.
  hasAuthor: codegraph docs <bootstrap>
  hasLifecycleStatus: accepted

• AntiPattern — "Low-value ranking for sizing"
  hasDescription: Demoting or ranking low-value files is an ineffective way to shrink adaptive explore output because the budget is refilled with other full bodies. Evidence: docs/design/adaptive-explore-sizing.md#1 Dead ends item 1 says broadening `isLowValuePath` barely changed size, from 28,478 to 28,424, and concludes ranking is not shrinking.
  hasAuthor: codegraph docs <bootstrap>
  hasLifecycleStatus: accepted
  hasTitle: Low-value ranking for sizing

• AntiPattern — "Name-keyed supertype union"
  hasDescription: Looking up supertypes by class name alone is an anti-pattern because common class names can union unrelated parents and create cross-class wrong edges. Evidence: docs/design/function-ref-capture.md#1 Known limits says name-keyed `getSupertypes('Engine')` unioned every Rails `Engine` parent and produced a wrong edge, while the node-anchored walk eliminated it.
  hasAuthor: codegraph docs <bootstrap>
  hasLifecycleStatus: accepted
  yieldsLesson: https://moosedev.dev/kg/Lesson/def86fd7-b4b8-4a8d-80d1-b1674274d733

  hasDescription: Allowing installer-enableable telemetry in the private codegraph-pro fork is an anti-pattern because customer containers guarantee nothing leaves the box. Evidence: docs/design/telemetry.md#0 codegraph-pro rule.

  hasDescription: Running framework `detect()` before file extraction is an anti-pattern for resolvers that consult the indexed file list, because it silently drops valid framework resolvers. Evidence: docs/design/mixed-ios-and-react-native-bridging.md#2 §8c says the construction-time initialize pass happened before indexing, so all `context.getAllFiles()` / `context.readFile()` based framework resolvers returned false and dropped themselves.

  hasDescription: Using only the deterministic probe query to validate skeletonization is unsafe because the probe can disagree with the real agent query about named symbols, spines, skeletonized files, and read-backs.   hasDescription: Ungated local RHS and variable-initializer matching is an anti-pattern because ordinary locals can collide with unique same-named functions elsewhere and create wrong callback-registration edges. Evidence: docs/design/function-ref-capture.md#0 Precision rule 2 says `prev = next`, `*str = field`, and `arena_ind_prev = arena_ind` in redis/jemalloc produced wrong edges when RHS/varinit were ungated.

  hasDescription: Claiming a framework is covered after one dispatch shape is an anti-pattern because it hides other shapes in the same framework.   hasDescription: Keeping only the first N files full and skeletonizing the rest is unsafe because it can collapse distinct non-sibling flow steps. Evidence: docs/design/adaptive-explore-sizing.md#1 Dead ends item 4 says a plain core-floor gate skeletonized Excalidraw's distinct steps and caused a 17% cost regression; the sibling condition is what makes skeletonization safe.

  hasDescription: A framework resolver hook declared only in the interface and never invoked is an anti-pattern because shipped framework extractors silently contribute no route nodes or route-handler edges.   hasDescription: Matching generic built-in bridge names as framework bridge targets is an anti-pattern because it turns ubiquitous platform methods into false cross-language edges. Evidence: docs/design/mixed-ios-and-react-native-bridging.md#2 §8d says NSObject-wide names would bridge to arbitrary project-local ObjC methods as noise, and RNFirebase initially had 78 edges including 60 false positives to `addListener:` / `remove:` before the RCTEventEmitter blocklist cut it to 18 precise edges.
